name: Helicone
description: Apache-2.0 LLM observability proxy, now reported to be in maintenance mode.
descriptionZh: Apache-2.0 的 LLM 可观测代理，据报道已进入维护模式。
keyFact: Helicone is an Apache-2.0 LLM observability platform known for one-line integration by changing the API base URL; its backend runs on Cloudflare Workers with ClickHouse and Kafka and the vendor reported over 2 billion handled calls, but multiple sources report it entered maintenance mode after an acquisition by Mintlify in March 2026.
keyFactZh: Helicone 是 Apache-2.0 的 LLM 可观测平台，以「改一行 baseURL」的接入方式著称；其后端由 Cloudflare Workers + ClickHouse + Kafka 构成，厂商称已处理 20 亿+ 调用，但多方报道称其在 2026 年 3 月被 Mintlify 收购后进入维护模式。
caveat: Reported to be in maintenance mode following a March 2026 acquisition; verify current activity before adopting for new production use.
caveatZh: 据报道在 2026 年 3 月被收购后进入维护模式；用于新生产项目前请先确认其当前活跃度。
